_meta.semantics: Empty last-user text -> getDecision('') -> in-process fallback envelope (standard_chat, no skill block) -> progress path (stream absent !== false) with decision_done frame.
_meta.normalization: Stage-event "ms" timing values replaced with "<ms>" in logicalFrames; progress-path response bodies are stored ms-normalized (raw bytes carry volatile ms digits). P1 (2026-11-01): the live <runtime_clock> system block carries wall-clock text, so its content is MASKED in bodyText/bodyJson (the clock text itself is pinned by clock unit tests).

messages.content:
RESPONSE POLICY FOR THIS ASSISTANT:
- Answer the request that was actually made, at the depth it asks for: a short question gets a short, direct answer; an explicit request for detail, comparison or steps gets the detail.
- Ordinary small talk and status questions stay brief and natural. Do not convert them into a report, a plan, or a list.
- Do not advertise capabilities, tools, integrations or services unless the human asks what you can do or what is available.
- Never describe work that is not actually happening: no claimed searches, files, background jobs, indexing or progress that did not run.
- If something is not possible here, say so plainly in one line instead of replacing it with a broader offer.

body.note: raw byte stream contains volatile ms digits in stage frames; compare logicalFrames + bodyMsNormalized, never raw bytes
